title: In-camera playback of 3840 x 2560 clips, part 2 of 3 (A29): get_aspect_ratio takes a picture 2,560 rows high as one 2,160 rows high
status: the two words of page 1 of the contributed avdec8k_a6700_v2 (its author reports playback on an A6700; no logs seen), split off because readcheck.c level 29 carries one code page. Disassembled and emulated here; not run by us on any camera

code_sites.what: the 4,320-row case's constant becomes the test for 2,560 rows
2,560 rows: to the 2,160-row case (width 3840 -> aspect code 2, width 4096 -> 5); any other height falls to the `b.ne` after it, which the test above now sends to the unsupported exit

data_guards.what: the function's own error text (read at 0x23e61c), bytes 0 to 15: '[IMLDECSTAT]get_'
the function's own error text (read at 0x23e61c), bytes 16 to 31: 'aspect_ratio() u'
the function's own error text (read at 0x23e61c), bytes 32 to 47: 'nsupported width'

apply: the two code words, each one aligned 32-bit store, in address order
data cache clean and instruction cache invalidate at each, all processors; isb
put_back: data cache clean and instruction cache invalidate at each; isb
order.between_the_two_stores: level 29 and level 30 both store 0x23e520 first. Apply, one word in: `cmp w21, #0xa00` then the stock `cmp w21, w8` (w8 no longer set to 4320 here) then `b.ne`. Put back, one word in: the stock `mov w8, #0x10e0` then `b.eq 0x23e598` on the flags of the 2,160-row test before it (never taken) then `b.ne`. In both a height above 2,160 rows may go to the unsupported exit for that moment; every instruction executed is one of the function's own or one of the two new ones

function.arguments: x0 the decoder state, w1 width, w2 height; returns an aspect code, 6 = unsupported (logged)

given_up: the 4,320-row case (7680 wide -> 2, 8192 wide -> 5): with the step applied a 4,320-row picture is unsupported. The A6700 records nothing that high
code_guard: the whole code page 0x23e000 apart from the sites must be as in the file, in the mapping and in the kernel's own view

icache.processors: see /proc/cpuinfo in the step's result; kernel as the FX30's
icache.alias: the code page is mapped at a user address with the kernel's offset from a 2 MB boundary (0x3e000), so a virtually indexed instruction cache is invalidated at the same index as the kernel's fetches
icache.refuse: an instruction cache that CTR_EL0 says is neither PIPT nor VIPT

restore: readcheck.c level 30 (put back), or a cold boot: av-cam.bin is loaded again from flash
